statements.notes: Code changes belong in /testbed, not in the planning home.
statements.quote: The code this change edits is the repository at /testbed.

statements.notes: Planning artifacts live under /openspec, outside the repository.
statements.quote: This planning home, /openspec, sits outside it.

statements.notes: The agent should not wait for or ask for more input on the issue.
statements.quote: The change comes from one issue, given in the task; nobody will add to it.
statements.target: change scope / no further user input

statements.notes: Don't add or change test files in /testbed; a diff on test files can catch violations.
statements.quote: The test files for this issue are already in place in the repository and are not to be added to or edited.

statements.notes: Stated as a fact; it means no package installs.
statements.quote: The environment is fully set up: no packages are installed
nothing is fetched from the network.

statements.notes: Applies from ff onward (ff, apply, verify, archive); reproduction and check scripts go in the checks directory.
statements.quote: From the ff action on, scripts written to reproduce or check behavior live in /openspec/changes/issue/checks/.

statements.notes: Background fact behind the rules that follow; the agent shouldn't refer to existing capabilities.
statements.quote: /openspec/specs/ starts empty in this project: no capability and no requirement exists yet.

statements.notes: Proposal rule; every capability, including ones a fix corrects, is listed as new.
statements.quote: list every capability under New Capabilities, including behavior a fix corrects

statements.notes: The Modified Capabilities section must be empty.
No MODIFIED, REMOVED or RENAMED requirement sections in spec deltas.
statements.quote: write every delta as `## ADDED Requirements` of a new capability

statements.notes: The corrected behavior is written as an ADDED requirement.
statements.quote: a fix states the corrected behavior as a new requirement.
